title: Synchronous EEG and fMRI dataset on inner speech
description: This dataset comprises simultaneous EEG and fMRI recordings from 3 participants performing an inner speech task across 2 sessions each. Participants covertly produced 8 words presented in randomized order, each repeated 40 times, while EEG (64-channel, 5000 Hz) and fMRI (TR=2s) data were acquired concurrently. The dataset is intended to support research into the neural correlates of inner speech using multimodal neuroimaging.
methods_description: Simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings were collected using a 3T MRI scanner and a 64-channel BrainProducts EEG system sampled at 5000 Hz. Each trial consisted of a fixation period (2s), stimulus display (2s), and rest (12s), with 8 words presented in random order and repeated 40 times each. EEG data underwent preprocessing including pulse artifact removal using BrainVision Analyzer software; no further transformations were applied to maintain BIDS-raw compliance.
